understanding.goal_understanding: Place all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked '+' at the same time; if there are multiple '+' tiles, every one must be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and complete the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you use CLICK on a grid coordinate to move the currently selected piece toward/onto that tile along valid paths/lines. Movement fails (piece stays put) if the destination is blocked by walls/obstacles or if the attempted action has no movement effect. Selection determines which piece moves; clicks on reachable open tiles reposition that piece, while repeated clicks on blocked targets (e.g., [35,17]) consume steps without moving. Pushing, if present, would require an unobstructed push direction and would be prevented by walls/blocked spaces similarly.
